race.title: racingtv.com/freetrial Flat Race
race.verdict: Gordon Elliott has taken this prize in 2 of the past 3 years and his Poet's Word gelding GREENBRIER , placed on his sole run in a point, is taken to add to the tally with last year's winning rider Harry Swan in the saddle again. Red Seagull rates the pick of those with experience and is next on the list ahead of River Cartwright and Distraction . GREENBRIER (IRE) RED SEAGULL (IRE) RIVER CARTWRIGHT (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Distraction (7/4), Red Seagull (11/4), River Cartwright (4/1), Greenbrier (6/1), Sumoscalier (8/1), Mhi Milani (16/1), Order Of The King (33/1), Ruthless Rebel (33/1), Deadly Diva (66/1), Hoof And Hustle (66/1), Mister Moon (100/1), Cash Chase (150/1)

past_results.ride_description: Tracked leaders, pushed along over 2f out, ridden in 5th over 1f out, no extra in 6th over 100 yards out, kept on one pace
Tracked leaders in 3rd, not fluent 3rd, briefly dropped to 5th before 3 out, went 3rd again and not fluent 2 out, pushed along from last and kept on well into 2nd run-in, not threatening winner
